text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ takes the Japanese
Derby crown,
but instead of feeling joy,
she comes away with a
sense of fear.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Despite her numerous calculations,
Winning
Ticket and Нарита Таисин both
have something
that keeps defying her
estimations.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She tries to figure out what that
"something"
might be and concludes
that she lacks what they
possess—an iron
will to succeed.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Upon reaching this conclusion, she asks
me to
increase her training intensity so
she won't lose at
the Kikuka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
